summary: The plan rewords the ~0-converting preview-page review ask into delight/pride-anchored honest copy across all three render paths (including the post-share heading override the earlier draft missed) and adds a nearly-free ride-along review_section_viewed instrument so a future cycle can finally separate 'never scrolled into view' from 'seen and ignored'. Every number reproduces exactly, it is a genuinely new mechanism on a dead surface (not a repeat, not an owner-rejected idea, breaks no discount/email/print mechanism, and improves Amazon-TOS alignment) and it is honestly labelled unmeasurable; I would defend it.

findings.issue: The new ride-along event 'review_section_viewed' is not yet registered in analytics-events.js, which ANALYTICS.md names as the single source of truth for event strings ('Add a new event there first, then use the constant' — a past silent rename once broke every review dashboard).
findings.evidence: grep 'review_section_viewed' over analytics-events.js and video-preview.html returns nothing, and no IntersectionObserver exists in video-preview.html today — this is genuinely new wiring. The canonical list defines PREVIEW_OPENED / REVIEW_CLICKED as constants; the plan's mechanism calls logFunnel('review_section_viewed', ...) as a bare string and never mentions adding the constant.
findings.required_fix: During build, add the REVIEW_SECTION_VIEWED constant to analytics-events.js and reference the constant, then confirm the event lands in log_video_funnel_events with phase=preview and source video_preview_buyer/receiver before any future H1b-vs-H3 read relies on it.

findings.issue: This is honest small polish (prize ~a few reviews/fortnight, admittedly unmeasurable at ~28 preview opens/window against a ~13-20pt bar) and it defers the audit-recommended higher-per-person leak #2 (warm users gave-email -> started-video, and the never-attacked examples/occasion screen).
findings.evidence: plan.measurable=false and expected_effect concede the copy bet will read 'not yet measurable' for many cycles. funnel-report 14d/until=2026-07-22 shows message_written=8 and create_clicked=8 vs video_started=35 and role_selected=62 — the in-app sub-step denominators are far too small to localize leak #2 this cycle, so deferring it (rather than betting on an unverifiable cause on a LIVE conversion path — the exact error the 07-16/last cycle was burned on) is defensible, not a defect.
findings.required_fix: None required to build; labelling is already honest. Keep leak #2 (examples/occasion screen) named as the next real prize once the repaired diagnostic or restored PostHog access gives a localizable read, so it is not quietly dropped.
